passives.name: UnohanaEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
If $KenpachiEVO is in range, for this unit:
- Switch to $Unohana_Skill3
- +{1}% Damage
- +{2}% Range

When this unit performs $Unohana_Skill3, for any $KenpachiEVO in range:
- Stun that unit for {3}s, bypassing any immunities
- Enhance that unit's next attack for +{4}% damage dealt
- Enable that unit's next attack to stun this unit and all enemies in range for {5}s
